title: Japan Family Holiday
headline: Tokyo for the children, Kyoto for the temples, trains in between.
description: A seven-night family Japan: four nights in Tokyo, three in Kyoto, with rail instead of airport hops.
image_alt: Kiyomizu-dera Temple with cherry blossoms in Kyoto
price_label: Quoted for your family and rail
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, season and child rail fares. Park tickets and international flights sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: Two cities, two hotels. Tokyo has the teamLab-or-Disney day if you want one; Kyoto keeps temple mornings short. Shinkansen between them. Built so younger children are not asked to do Hakone as well.
highlights: Four nights in one Tokyo hotel.
Optional Disney, teamLab or Ghibli day as quoted.
Three nights in Kyoto with one early temple morning.
why: Park days only when you add tickets.
Daily load can be cut for younger children.
inclusions: Airport transfer in Tokyo as quoted
Breakfast where the hotel includes it
Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
exclusions: Japan visa fees if they apply
Disney, teamLab, Ghibli and temple tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels in Tokyo and Kyoto
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Park tickets are dated and sell out; they are confirmed only in the written quote. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order: Tokyo, then Kyoto. A Hakone day trip can replace a Tokyo leisure day if you ask.
